title: senna sericea
intro: Senna sericea, commonly known as silver leaf cassia, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family of legumes. The health benefits of Senna sericea include its ability to treat various gastrointestinal issues, such as constipation, diarrhea, and dyspepsia, due to its purgative properties. The therapeutic actions of Senna sericea are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements and relieve symptoms associated with irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). The bioactive constituents of Senna sericea include sennosides, anthraquinones, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
